recipes.name: No-Bake Chocolate Eclair Cake
ingredients_raw: 2 (3 ounce) packages instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine pudding mix and 3 cups milk; mix well. Fold in whipped topping and beat with mixer for 2 minutes.
In a buttered 9x13 inch baking dish, spread a layer of graham crackers on the bottom of the dish.
Spread 1/2 of the pudding mixture over crackers, then top with graham crackers. Spread remaining pudding over crackers; top second pudding layer with another layer of crackers.
To make topping: In a medium saucepan over medium-high heat, combine 1/4 cup milk, cocoa and sugar and allow to boil for 1 minute; remove from heat and add butter and vanilla. Mix well and cool.
Pour sauce over graham cracker layer and refrigerate until set; serve.

raw_recipe.headline: No-Bake Chocolate Eclair Cake
raw_recipe.description: Chocolate graham crackers layered between creamy vanilla custard, topped with chocolate glaze. Satisfy your sweet tooth with this quick and easy dessert.

review.reviewBody: Only difference was out of necessity: I used half and half for the pudding mix as I was out of milk. So very rich and creamy! My husband said this was the best dessert I have ever made.... rave reviews by all who sampled!

I use regular grahams, French Vanilla pudding, and follow the recipe. Where I take a detour is on the chocolate topping. Aileen Lissette. thanks for your recommendations of the 12 TB butter, 12 TB cocoa(used Hersheys Special dark) 2.5 C powdered (confectioners) sugar, 4 TB hot water( occasionally, I’ve had to use a TB or 2 more, if my mix is too stiff/dry to spread) 2 tsp of vanilla. I always let my eclair cake refrigerate overnight or if I have two days available I will do that. Thing is awesome!

Delicious and easy! This is a great crowd-pleaser. I made only a few minor changes to this delightful recipe. I doubled the sauce because the first time I did this recipe I felt it needed more chocolate glaze. I bought regular graham crackers, and I used French Vanilla pudding. Use a whisk to mix the pudding, a spoon does not mix the milk and powder very well. Then fold in the cool whip. I did not have to butter the pan. Also, the chocolate topping was a bit grainy the first time I made it because of the granulated sugar. So, the next time I used a chocolate glaze recipe from another reviewer. I used 12 tb of butter, 12 tb of cocoa powder, 2.5 c. of powdered sugar, 4 tb of hot water and 2 tsp of vanilla. Much better!! Waiting over night makes all the difference. We ate it for Easter the following day and was well received by all! Thank you!

This is so good! However I made a few tweaks, I like more pudding in mine so I did 3 packs of pudding and only 1/2 tub of extra creamy cool whip. Instead of making the chocolate topping with cocoa powder, I made a ganache using 1 cup semi sweet chocolate chips and 1 cup heavy cream (just put the chips in a bowl, bring the cream to a boil and pour over the chips, stir and let it melt them, stir again to make smooth and pour over top of the cake. So delicious!

I crushed the graham crackers and mixed them with butter for the crust and the second layer. I added 8 ounces of cream cheese to the pudding mix. I also used sugar free pudding and cool whip, since my husband is diabetic. I used a square pan so the dessert will be higher. I used stevia for the topping, but added a little real sugar after tasting because it was bitter. Delicious !! I will definitely make this again.

I needed a quick dessert for an impromptu dinner. I did not have (2) 3 oz. pkackages of vanilla pudding so I used most of (2) 5.1 oz. packages and I used real whipped cream with a teaspoon of powdered sugar added instead of cool whip. Also, I added sliced bananas and flaked coconut to the custard layer. I only had cinnamon grahams so I used them and it ws delicious. Sprinkled top of chocolate with coconut. This dessert was a huge hit. Looked and tasted like it came from a bakery.

i made this with just a few changes i added 1 tsp vanilla to the pudding mixture and did 3 layers then for the topping i used 4T butter 4T milk 4 T cocoa powder 5T sugar and 1 t vanilla heated the butter and milk till butter melted added the rest of ing. and drizzled it over puddin and let it sit OVERNIGHT in fridge it was awesome and today i'm trying it with butterscotch

Great Recipe!! Even though I made alterations to fit my personal taste and what I had on hand, I am sure this would be just as great following the recipe. I used regular graham crackers, (1)sugar free white chocolate pudding (1) Sugar free vanilla pudding and french vanilla cool whip. As others suggested I also doubled the topping recipe. ******The topping is a must, the recipe just says to bring it too a boil, but if you bring it to a rolling boil and time it for (2) minutes before removing it from the heat it sets on the desert much better, and tastes just like the icing on an eclair, YUMMM. Thanks for the great recipe!!

I have been making this recipe for years. The only difference is that I use canned frosting. Make sure you remove all of the foil before you microwave. It takes about 20-30 seconds to melt and then you pour it over the top. Our family loves this dessert!

This is a great recipe and so easy to make. Every time I make it for potlucks someone asks me to share the recipe. The only thing I do different is add extra melted butter to the frosting. Only using 2 tablespoons make a harder frosting that tends to crack. If you use 4 to 6 tablespoons you will get a softer glaze like you would find on an eclair. I think it tastes better with regular honey grahams crackers over the chocolate ones, but it is good either way. I find that the chocolate graham crackers are sweeter since they are coated with sugar and they tend to get a little mushier than the honey grahams, so the texture is a bit different. Also, let it sit in the refrigerator at least 8 hours for best results. I cannot imagine ever substiting this frosting with the store-bought kind. You must try it!

For the ultimate version that everyone will rave about...use regular honey graham crackers w/ French Vanilla instant pudding. (Chocolate graham crackers are fine w/ reg. Vanilla instant pudding.) Make the frosting on the stove w/ the cocoa... the frosting from the can just doesn't cut it. It is quick, easy, and everyone thinks you spent hours making the dessert.
Very easy to make. I used banana pudding instead of vanilla. Everyone loved it.

I’ve made this for years. Instead of making the chocolate sauce, I use a can of chocolate fudge frosting and put it in the microwave for 1 minute. Stir it and it has the consistency of chocolate sauce
I used Hershey Chocolate Sauce in a can instead of making it. Cocoa is kind of expensive here.
I love it

I have done this recipe 3 seperate times now. My family is not huge on grahmn wafers so once i used puff pastry sheets, another pillsbury cresent rolls, and another using wafer cookies (divided). Everytime a hit!!!! It goes over at my house like chocolate lasagna!!! Thanks for the recipe!!

I used regular graham crackers and ran out so I crumbled the top layer. I also drank half of the chocolate topping so I drizzled instead of spreading fully. Quick and easy! Family of 6 all ages loved it!
Made this for my husband's birthday; he loved it and so did one of our granddaughters. I made it with regular graham instead of chocolate ones. It turned out very good!

My husband has diabetes and it is hard to find desserts he can eat. This one worked great. Substituted pudding and whipped topping with sugar-free versions. For the chocolate sauce, heated some zero sugar chocolate frosting and poured over the top. My husband loved it! Even better the next day since the crackers soften and break easier so the custard doesn't squirt out.
She good but we used regular graham crackers and chocolate fudge frosting from a can, we melted it and it was perfect after overnight in refrigerator.
